description: Scan untrusted text for prompt-injection patterns and Unicode obfuscation before an agent acts on it. Deterministic known-pattern matching plus hidden-character detection, not a classifier: novel phrasing is not covered. Pass text directly, or a url to fetch and scan. Runs fully locally: the input never leaves this machine.

url.description: A page to fetch and scan instead of text. Fetching is SSRF-guarded.

name: scan_content
